subject: Re: HelioCorp renewal — order form redlines & coverage schedule
messages:
From: Alyssa White <alyssa.white@heliocorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@heliocorp.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal redlines — HelioCorp order form v3 attached

Jasmine / Laura —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is our consolidated redline (Helio_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx) and a short summary PDF of MSA markup (Helio_MSA_diff-annotations.pdf). Key asks from procurement and security: 

- Term: propose moving from 12-month to 24-month with a step-down option at month 18 if usage falls below 60% of committed capacity.
- Coverage schedule: we need clearer language on burst capacity and how throughput tiers map to unit pricing (we flagged mismatched tier breakpoints).
- Data retention & keys: Helio requests a clause confirming BYOK/KMS integration and an audit log retention window of 24 months.
- Credits: ask for a one-time onboarding credit tied to delivery of prefix-KV cache export (to validate migration).

We prefer to get a redline-to-redline so legal can close quickly. Can you confirm the earliest Redwood legal can respond with a tracked Word doc? Also, procurement attached PO-HE-4491.pdf — they prefer a DocuSign path but will accept an emailed signature.

Would appreciate a point person on the Redwood side to shepherd the MSA + order form changes (and confirm whether any SLA/coverage concessions are required to grant the 24-month term).

Thanks,
Alyssa White
Sr. Procurement Manager — HelioCorp
Alyssa.white@heliocorp.com

Attachments: Helio_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx, Helio_MSA_diff-annotations.pdf, PO-HE-4491.pdf

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa White <alyssa.white@heliocorp.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal redlines — HelioCorp order form v3 attached

Thanks Alyssa — looping in Marissa (Legal) and Laura (AM) to triage. High level summary from our side:

- 24-month term: commercially ok but want to preserve our right to adjust list pricing at annual renewal; can propose a fixed schedule for the first 12 months then CPI-based adjustments after month 12.
- Step-down at month 18: acceptable with a clear measurement window (we propose 30-day rolling average usage vs committed baseline).
- Burst & tiers: we need to reconcile how bursts are invoiced vs capacity pools — Laura, can you sketch expected monthly token profile? That will help legal craft objective tier breakpoints.
- BYOK/KMS: engineering confirms BYOK is supported on Redwood Private and Dedicated; need to confirm Helio’s key provider (KMS vendor) to validate integration path.
- Onboarding credit: we can offer a 10% one-time credit applied to first invoice contingent on successful KV prefix export.

Marissa — can you take the Helio redlines (attached) and: 1) mark up the MSA differences focusing on term & audit retention language, 2) call out any new SLA exposure if we accept the step-down, and 3) propose fallback language for price changes? If we want to propose tracked changes back by Tuesday EOD, that should keep this deal on the current cadence.

Alyssa — I'll own the commercial side; Marissa will handle legal language. Laura will own usage mapping and PO acceptance.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Alyssa White <alyssa.white@heliocorp.com>, contracts@heliocorp.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal redlines — HelioCorp order form v3 attached

Jasmine / team —

I reviewed Helio's redlines and prepared a marked-up MSA with commentary (see Helio_MSA_diff-annotations.pdf). Summary of legal positions and recommended edits: 

1) Term & Price protection: Redwood can accept a 24-month term if we secure a price protection clause for the first 12 months (no rate increases) and CPI-based adjustments thereafter (cap at +6% annually). Add explicit notice period for price changes (60 days).

2) Step-down metric: change Helio's proposed 60% threshold to a 65% threshold over a 45-day measurement window; this reduces churn risk. For step-down, require a 30-day remediation period and an optional one-time repricing adjustment rather than an automatic credit.

3) Burst billing & tiers: propose a tier reconciliation table in the order form with explicit per-token rates and a separate line item for on-demand burst at 1.6x the baseline tier price. This preserves predictability and gives Helio headroom.

4) BYOK & audit logs: we can confirm BYOK/KMS support; modify MSA to state Redwood will assist with integration during a 30-day technical onboarding window. Audit log retention: we can commit to 24 months for metadata and governance logs; raw customer content retention remains contractual and will be scoped in the order form (recommend 90-day default with optional 24-month addendum at customer request).

5) Onboarding credit: fine to grant a one-time onboarding credit (10% of first invoice) contingent on acceptance of the proposed measurement windows and remediation path.

Open items for commercial/legal alignment: 
- Helio's PO lists a condensed signature path. If Helio requires exceptions to Redwood's standard warranty/indemnity caps or data residency commitments, we need an escalation to GC — please flag if those redlines appear.
- We should include an SLA schedule that calls out latency SLOs for the committed tier and a remedy matrix (service credit only) tied to clear measurement windows.

Next steps: I'm attaching the annotated MSA and a short order-form redline (tracked Word) — I can send both to Alyssa as a single redline-to-redline if everyone is ready. I can target Tue 15 Dec EOD for the tracked Word if you confirm.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helio_MSA_diff-annotations.pdf, Redwood_OrderForm_feedback_track.docx

From: Alyssa White <alyssa.white@heliocorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal redlines — HelioCorp order form v3 attached

Thanks Marissa & team — this is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement after an internal sync: 

- 65% -> Helio pushes back; they want 60% as a softer step-down. Can we accept 62.5% as a compromise?
- Price protection cap of +6% is acceptable. Need the 60-day notice language in the tracked doc.
- Burst multiplier looks workable; can you add an explicit example invoice line so our billing team can validate?
- PO-HE-4491.pdf is ready for signature once the tracked redline-to-redline is received. They are ok with the DocuSign path.

Procurement asks for the tracked Word and a short summary deck (1 slide) that highlights differences in SLA/credits and the onboarding credit. If you can send the redline and a one-slide summary by EOD tomorrow, procurement will route the PO for signature.

I'll hold off on escalating GC items for now — we want to close this quickly.

Alyssa
Sr. Procurement Manager — HelioCorp
